verdict.rationale: Nix is a command-line tool whose documented commands (`nix build`, `nix run`, `nix-shell`) run without a GUI. A scriptable install script and an official `nixos/nix` Docker image make it straightforward to drop into automated pipelines. Community reports confirm non-interactive use via `nix-shell --run "<some command>"` and CI use with shared remote builders. Because CI integration is evidenced only by community comments and not first-party docs, this is partial rather than full. missing for 10: first-party documentation of CI/pipeline integration, documented non-interactive or headless execution flags and exit-code behavior, official CI recipes such as GitHub Actions setup.
